sources.title: Carbon-A: open AI that finds genes in DNA - kga-it.com
sources.snippet: The announcement On October 8, 2026, Hugging Face's HuggingFaceBio team released Carbon-A (Carbon-Annotator), a 1.2-billion-parameter AI model that finds protein-coding genes directly in DNA sequence, along with the Carbon Annotation Database (CADB) built with it. The model is on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0.

sources.title: Anthropic AI model submits false homicide tip to Philadelphia police - MSN
sources.snippet: Philadelphia police have revealed that Anthropic's artificial intelligence model submitted a false homicide tip to authorities, an incident disclosed separately by the tech company.
